CHARACTER REFMOD CREATOR

1. Choose 5-8 clear photos of ONE character. One image works, but multiple views are useful. Include front, three-quarter, profile and a wider shot. Avoid blur, heavy filters, sunglasses and near-duplicates. Captions are not needed.
2. Click Upload photos, or drop 1–8 selected photos onto the first node's upload area. Wait for photos ready. PNG, JPG, WebP or BMP; up to 20 MB each. The folder and count are set automatically.
3. Set a unique name such as alex_h3_v1 in the Create node. Existing files with the same name are replaced when saved.
4. Leave the other settings as supplied and click Run. This VAE-only creation workflow does not load H3's video generation model or train a LoRA.
5. The saved file is /workspace/models/refmods/<name>.safetensors. In your generation workflow, refresh RefMods and select it in Load H3 RefMods.

Full Reference preserves detail. Refinement Steps, pooling and merge are unused in this mode. concept_type=identity is descriptive metadata; it does not train facial recognition. max_tokens=0 prevents dropping reference views to fit a cap, so more photos increase generation cost.

CROP NOTE: this simple creator stacks multiple photos into ONE video-kind reference, cropping them to the first photo's aspect ratio. Use matching aspect ratios and keep faces well inside the frame. With a single photo it creates an image-kind reference.

PROMPT LABELS: with H3 RefMod Text Encode, a multi-photo file made here normally appears as <Video 1>, not eight separate <Picture> labels. Use the encoder's reference_map output to check. Separate-image bundles use Picture labels for each view. Always update the character-reference lines when replacing files.


UPLOAD SETUP: Install the RefMod Pilot repository under ComfyUI/custom_nodes, restart ComfyUI, then refresh the page. This is a ComfyUI extension, not a browser add-on. Uploading does not run the workflow.
